unused.why: unused private member / unread private member / unnecessary assignment / unused parameter

throwhelper.why: ArgumentNullException/ArgumentException/ArgumentOutOfRangeException/ObjectDisposedException throw helpers; the `?? throw` form is not covered by any of them (route X, team decision)

dispose.why: dispose objects before losing scope / disposable fields should be disposed

syncasync.why: call async methods when in an async method

dbl.why: TryGetValue / TryAdd / unnecessary Contains before Add/Remove

catch.why: do not catch general exception types

xmldoc.why: missing XML comment for publicly visible member (needs GenerateDocumentationFile)

fireforget.why: use ValueTasks correctly; discarded Task needs a new analyzer (route B)

nullforg.why: comments say a `!` hides a value that can really be null; deciding that needs judgement per site. No CA/IDE rule reports a needed-but-wrong `!` (IDE0370 reports only unnecessary suppressions)

linq.why: LINQ is allowed outside hot paths; needs a project-scoped NETH analyzer or BannedApi

sleep.why: no CA/IDE rule for Thread.Sleep/Task.Delay in tests

testcase.why: duplicate test bodies need a new analyzer

arraypool.why: Rent without Return in finally needs a new analyzer

skip.why: stackalloc without SkipLocalsInit needs a new analyzer

methodimpl.why: mostly perf taste; narrow part (AggressiveInlining on async/try) would be route B

logguard.why: guard dominance check needs a new analyzer

nameof.why: use nameof in place of string
